problem: The positive-sigma sampled-preaction channel and policy-average center use the same continuous F without a channel selector. Exact realized-action regression near u=mu conflicts with an expected-value center when action curvature is nonzero.
qualifications: Clipping changes the polynomial formula but retains the mismatch: Q(0)=0 versus positive E[clip(sigma eps)²].
Highly expressive finite networks can form narrow center ridges. This is an incompatible exact smooth population fit, not a positive lower bound on infimum error for arbitrary networks.
Finite batch, bootstrap bias, derivative identification and actor movement remain.
Coverage v24 may still help continuation accuracy; this critique is a separate objective issue.
